title: Heroine Syndicate: Blessing of Goddess

images.alt: Heroine Syndicate: Blessing of Goddess [えびせんワークス]

body.intro:
-----
Update:
Ver 1.01 : Fixed an problem about Minori at the Arena Mode.
Ver 1.03 : Translated the scenario file, EventPackE.txt.
-----
*First
You can modify scenario text for translation. Read text files included in the archive file.
(Only Product Version.)

*Abstract
This game is a platformer that a heroine, "Makoto," tries to get out her sister, "Minori," from an evil secret sect, "Hallowed Syndicate."
If the blessing of her arms is gone, she will fall among enemies.

Blessing is managed by a "God Gauge." Keeping it "Enabled" lets player concentrate just on playing.

To keep it seamless, sex scenes are given expression by standing entire body images.


*Game System
- Simple platform action.
It is easy, so anyone can enjoy this game with arms. ([C key or 3 button] with Up cursor.)
However, it is hard to beat without arms. Less offensive distance and more damage. You can try to beat it with no arms.

You can use a game pad.


- Changing blessing for play styles
Makoto's arms, "Meria Descender," avoids ra*e from enemies.
However, if Meria sleeps ...

Make Meria awake to enjoy playing, and make her sleep to enjoy H-motion.


- Arena Mode
After beating the game, you can enjoy "Arena Mode" where you can place enemies as you like.
This mode is playable one-handed with the mouse.


- Diorama Mode
When you fail with specific conditions, some diorama scenes will be activated.
You can access them from the title scene after beating the game.

In Diorama Mode, you can still do limited actions, jumping, escape, and so on.


- High Score
Off-line high score ranking is available.
If you rank high enough, it will be registered and you can tweet it.
(Needs browser and network connection.)


*Update
Updates and fixes may be applied from time to time.
You should purchase with a registered account to re-download.
